components.purpose: Page intro section — headline (e.g. "How We Compare") and supporting description framing the product-vs-competitors comparison.
Core feature-by-feature comparison grid — Column Names field holds our product + the two competitors, and the linked Rows (ComparisonRow) hold each feature with its per-column values.
Addresses follow-up questions prospects have after seeing the comparison (e.g. migration, pricing nuances, edge-case features not in the table).
Closing call-to-action encouraging the visitor to sign up / request a demo / talk to sales now that they've seen why the product wins.
